relationships.subject: anti-TNF-α antibody
relationships.evidence_quote: microinjecting TNF-α neutralization antibody into the contralateral ACC 1 day before SNI and again on each of the 7 days following SNI (Figure 6A) could significantly mitigate SNI-induced ipsilateral mechanical allodynia

relationships.subject: ACC TNF-α
relationships.evidence_quote: The Western blot showed that the SNI-induced overexpression of TNF-α and p-MLKL in the ACC was inhibited by microinjecting TNF-α neutralizing antibodies into the ACC

relationships.subject: MLKL
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot confirmed that MLKL siRNA effectively reduced the levels of p-MLKL and TNF-α in the contralateral ACC

relationships.subject: MLKL
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that MLKL siRNA could partially alleviate the decrease in PWT induced by SNI.

relationships.subject: ACC TNF-α
relationships.evidence_quote: Necroptosis triggered by TNF-α in the PV-INs of the ACC may be a key contributor to the E/I imbalance in the ACC and neuroimmune responses following peripheral nerve injury.

key_findings: SNI increased p-RIP1, RIP3, p-RIP3 and p-MLKL in the contralateral ACC, mainly in PV interneurons, with TNF-α colocalized with p-RIP3/p-MLKL in PV-INs, and induced an E/I imbalance (more CaMKII, fewer vGAT terminals).
Intra-ACC anti-TNF-α antibody or MLKL siRNA alleviated SNI-induced mechanical allodynia and reduced ACC TNF-α and p-MLKL.
